title: 第13章 那个舔狗怎么还不来
novel_title: 九恶妃每日一问，陛下驾崩了吗？
content_zh:
梦妃寝宫。

    唐梦宫自昨夜回来后，便一直站在院中，已经站了整整一夜。

    她一动不动，宛如一尊雕塑，只有一袭白衣在风中猎猎作响。

    眼看着正午到了，唐梦宫神色愈发的冰冷危险，整个院子里都充斥着一股窒息感。

    剑侍们静候在周围，一个个心都悬到了嗓子眼。

    “门口的花篮还是空的？”唐梦宫漠然道。

    “回禀主人，是，是的。”

    剑侍的话音未落，整个院落里陡然掀起一阵惊天剑气。

    空气中传出瘆人的空间撕裂声。

    一道道黑线遍布四面八方。

    “主人息怒！！”

    一众剑侍们扑通扑通跪地。

    唐梦宫美眸凝视着帝王寝殿的方向，柳眉倒竖，银牙都快要咬碎了。

    “混蛋！居然还不来跟本小姐道歉！”

    “今日若不来，那以后就不要再来了！！”

    吱嘎。

    这时候，小院的门忽然被轻轻推开。

    唐梦宫急忙扭头望向门口。

    但看到的并非是期待的身影，而是一个小心翼翼的剑侍。

    “何事？”唐梦宫冷冷道。

    “回禀主人，二公子到了，他说需要些资源，想去一趟皇宫宝库。”

    唐梦宫一甩手，院门轰然关闭。

    “滚！让那废物滚远点！”

    “可，可是主人，是王爷让二少爷来的。”

    “那也滚！”

    “是。”

    ……

    秦然离开了晗妃小院。

    离开时，将任务奖励的驻颜丹留给了徐若晗。

    这宫里，没人比徐若晗更需要驻颜丹。

    在来之前，秦然本意是用驻颜丹，更深一步拉近徐若晗的好感。

    但最后送出之时，他的想法已经完全变了，只将驻颜丹当成了一份简单纯粹的礼物。

    他不忍心用利益来玷污这个纯粹且无辜的女人……

    走在深宫大道上。

    秦然心中依旧萦绕着徐若晗那简单却纯粹的温情，这纸片人在他心中立体了，独具生命力。

    “或许，有些真心不该被辜负…”

    “接下来，该去给种玉仙身找找合适的神魔血了。”

    “青符，调头去皇家宝库。”
content_en:
Meng Fei's bedroom.

    Tang Menggong has been standing in the courtyard since he came back last night. He has been standing all night.

    She was motionless, like a sculpture, with only her white clothes rustling in the wind.

    Seeing that noon had arrived, Tang Menggong's expression became increasingly cold and dangerous, and the entire courtyard was filled with a sense of suffocation.

    The swordsmen were waiting around silently, their hearts in their throats.

    "The flower basket at the door is still empty?" Tang Menggong said indifferently.

    "Reporting to the master, yes, yes."

    Before the sword attendant finished speaking, a burst of shocking sword energy suddenly arose in the entire courtyard.

    There was a terrifying sound of space tearing in the air.

    Black lines spread in all directions.

    "Master, calm down!!"

    All the swordsmen fell to their knees.

    Tang Menggong's beautiful eyes stared in the direction of the emperor's chamber, her eyebrows stood upright, and her silver teeth were almost broken.

    "Asshole! You haven't even come to apologize to me!"

    “If you don’t come today, don’t come again in the future!!”

    squeak.

    At this time, the door of the small courtyard was suddenly pushed open gently.

    Tang Menggong hurriedly turned to look at the door.

    But what he saw was not the expected figure, but a cautious swordsman.

    "What's the matter?" Tang Menggong said coldly.

    "Reporting to the master, the second young master has arrived. He said he needs some resources and wants to visit the palace treasure house."

    Tang Menggong waved his hand and the courtyard door slammed shut.

    "Get lost! Get that trash away!"

    "Yes, but master, it was the prince who asked the second young master to come."

    "Then get out of here!"

    "Yes."

    …

    Qin Ran left Concubine Han's courtyard.

    When leaving, he left Xu Ruohan the Zhuyan Pill rewarded by the mission.

    No one in this palace needs Zhu Yan Dan more than Xu Ruohan.

    Before coming, Qin Ran's original intention was to use the Beauty Pill to get closer to Xu Ruohan.

    But when he finally gave it away, his mind had completely changed, and he only regarded the Zhuyan Pill as a simple and pure gift.

    He couldn't bear to use his profits to taint this pure and innocent woman...

    Walking on the deep palace avenue.

    Xu Ruohan's simple but pure warmth still lingers in Qin Ran's heart. This paper figure has become three-dimensional in his heart and has its own vitality.

    "Perhaps, some sincerity should not be let down..."

    "Next, it's time to find suitable god and demon blood for the Jade Immortal Body."

    "Qing Fu, turn around and go to the Royal Treasure House."
title_en: Chapter 13 Why doesn’t that licking dog come?
